question: share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts

CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(*) AS donation_count
    FROM "donations"
    GROUP BY "Donor"
),
repeat_givers AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor"
    FROM donor_counts
    WHERE donation_count > 1
),
one_time_givers AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor"
    FROM donor_counts
    WHERE donation_count = 1
),
donor_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        d."Donor",
        d."Amount"
    FROM "donations" d
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN rg."Donor" IS NOT NULL THEN da."Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN otg."Donor" IS NOT NULL THEN da."Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS onetime_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rg."Donor" IS NOT NULL THEN da."Donor" END) AS repeat_giver_count,
        SUM(da."Amount") AS total_amount
    FROM donor_amounts da
    LEFT JOIN repeat_givers rg ON da."Donor" = rg."Donor"
    LEFT JOIN one_time_givers otg ON da."Donor" = otg."Donor"
)
SELECT
    (repeat_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_amount, 0)) AS share_of_money_from_repeat_givers_percent,
    repeat_giver_count
FROM totals;
